# Comprehensive KPI Definitions & Business Methodology

## Overview
This document defines the mathematical formulas, business logic, data boundaries, and analytical interpretations for all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) utilized in the **NovaPharm Market & Product Performance System**.

---

## 1. Revenue ($)
* **Definition:** Total gross revenue generated by NovaPharm from product sales in a specified time period and market segment.
* **Formula:**
  $$\text{Revenue} = \sum (\text{Units Sold} \times \text{Selling Price})$$
* **SQL Implementation:** `SUM(units_sold * selling_price)`
* **Interpretation:** Primary top-line financial metric evaluating commercial scale.

---

## 2. Market Share (%) — Value & Unit
* **Definition:** The percentage of total market revenue or unit volume captured by NovaPharm products relative to the overall market (NovaPharm + Competitors).
* **Formulas:**
  $$\text{Value Market Share (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{NovaPharm Product Revenue}}{\text{Total Market Revenue}} \right) \times 100$$
  $$\text{Unit Market Share (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{NovaPharm Units Sold}}{\text{Total Market Units}} \right) \times 100$$
* **SQL Implementation:**
  `ROUND((SUM(s.revenue) / SUM(m.total_market_value)) * 100, 2)`
* **Interpretation:** Measures competitive strength and market dominance within a therapeutic category.

---

## 3. Growth Rate (%) — YoY & MoM
* **Definition:** The percentage change in product revenue or unit sales compared to a prior reference period (Year-over-Year or Month-over-Month).
* **Formulas:**
  $$\text{YoY Growth (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Revenue}_{t} - \text{Revenue}_{t-12}}{\text{Revenue}_{t-12}} \right) \times 100$$
  $$\text{MoM Growth (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Revenue}_{t} - \text{Revenue}_{t-1}}{\text{Revenue}_{t-1}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Interpretation:** Indicates market momentum, product lifecycle trajectory, or seasonal demand shifts.

---

## 4. Evolution Index (EI)
* **Definition:** A standardized index measuring current period performance relative to a designated baseline period (where Base Period = `100.0`).
* **Formula:**
  $$\text{Evolution Index} = \left( \frac{\text{Performance}_{\text{Current Period}}}{\text{Performance}_{\text{Base Period (Jan 2024)}}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Threshold Benchmark:**
  * **EI > 110.0:** Accelerated growth / outperformance.
  * **EI = 95.0 – 110.0:** Stable / mature performance.
  * **EI < 95.0:** Market contraction or generic erosion.
* **Interpretation:** Allows apples-to-apples performance comparisons across products of vastly different revenue scales (e.g., $100M oncology drug vs $10M generic tablet).

---

## 5. Patient Penetration Rate (%)
* **Definition:** The proportion of addressable target patients reached by NovaPharm therapies within a region.
* **Formula:**
  $$\text{Penetration Rate (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Patients Reached}}{\text{Addressable Patient Population}} \right) \times 100$$
* **SQL Implementation:**
  `ROUND((SUM(pen.patients_reached) / SUM(pen.addressable_population)) * 100, 2)`
* **Interpretation:** Evaluates adoption depth and geographic expansion opportunities.

---

## 6. Price Index (PI)
* **Definition:** Benchmark ratio comparing NovaPharm's average selling price against competitor market average prices within the same therapeutic area.
* **Formula:**
  $$\text{Price Index} = \left( \frac{\text{NovaPharm Average Selling Price}}{\text{Competitor Average Selling Price}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Threshold Benchmark:**
  * **PI > 105.0:** Premium pricing strategy.
  * **PI = 95.0 – 105.0:** Parity pricing.
  * **PI < 95.0:** Discounted / aggressive pricing strategy.
* **Interpretation:** Assesses pricing power and risk of market share loss due to uncompetitive pricing.

---

## 7. Portfolio Revenue Contribution (%)
* **Definition:** The percentage share of total company revenue contributed by a single product or therapeutic area.
* **Formula:**
  $$\text{Revenue Contribution (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Product Revenue}}{\text{Total Company Portfolio Revenue}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Interpretation:** Used in Pareto (80/20) analysis to identify core revenue drivers vs tail products.
